as_told.title: Ingo Swann remote views the moon and is forced off by aliens

plain: A psychic named Ingo Swann is said to have travelled to the Moon in his mind and found aliens there who forced him off. This was done by what he called remote viewing, a claimed ability to see distant places with the mind alone. Michels brings it up, and his guest, the researcher Jeffrey Mishlove, who holds a PhD, tells it the same way as something Swann claimed. Mishlove puts it in the 1970s. If true, it would mean someone was living on the Moon and did not want to be watched.
